difficulty_reason: Presentation [U/R]; transport T to an R-invariant closed T' in |U| via points-presentation; take the reduced induced space Z on T'; smoothness of the two legs from Z makes the fibre products with R reduced (properties local for smooth topology), their equal supports force Z x_{U,t} R = R x_{s,U} Z by the uniqueness of reduced closed subspaces, so Z is R-invariant; the substack correspondence gives Z with the right support; unicity omitted (follows mechanically from the spaces-level uniqueness plus the same correspondence).
